residual_risks: No outside reporter check was performed, per the ground rules.

defect.proposed_fix: Replace the pin-op23 quote with the exact sentence from slip page 23, preserving the opinion's quotation marks, or paraphrase without quotation marks.

reasons: The lake/payload quote stops at "[a]" and omits the rest of the quoted phrase.
The content page's displayed quote also changes the opinion's nested quotation marks, so it is not character-faithful as a verbatim quote.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use exact opinion typography for the quoted sentence or convert the rule statement to a paraphrase.

defect.problem: The pin-op17 stored/payload quote is not the cited opinion quotation; it is harvested page boilerplate ending before the actual excessive-force sentence.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace pin-op17 with the actual opinion sentence beginning at slip page 17, or re-extract the quote from the cached opinion text.

reasons: The payload quote begins with the content page header, not the Sixth Circuit opinion text.
The actual cited passage appears in the opinion at slip page 17 and supports the displayed content-page quote, but the stored pinpoint quote itself is wrong.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Repair the quote-harvest boundary for pin-op17 so the pinpoint quote starts at the excessive-force holding sentence.

defect.locator_note: text/Wright v. City of Euclid__4893aa.txt lines 1134-1137; content_page.md line 57; lake pinpoint pin-op33
defect.problem: The quoted municipal-liability sentence is substantively complete and located in the opinion, but it is not character-faithful because the opinion uses curly apostrophes in City’s and Wright’s while the stored/page quote uses straight apostrophes.
defect.proposed_fix: Preserve the opinion text's apostrophes in City’s and Wright’s, or mark the quote as normalized rather than verbatim.

reasons: The sentence appears at the claimed slip-page location and matches in substance.
Character fidelity fails on apostrophe typography, which matters under the stated verbatim-quote standard.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use exact text extraction for pin-op33 rather than ASCII-normalized apostrophes.
